newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: MMK sees H1 group profit above H1 96 level.
newsitem.headline: MMK sees H1 group profit above H1 96 level.

text.p: Cartonboard maker Mayr-Melnhof said on Thursday it expected group profit in the first half of the year to be above the level posted in the same period in 1996.
"It is to be expected that the 1997 first half result will be above the 1996 first half," chairman of the board Michael Groeller told Reuters, but declined to give precise details.
The current order situation at the cardboard division is 110,000 tonnes, Groeller said. The cardboard division was used to full capacity in the first half, he noted.
The preliminary first half figures are due in mid-July and the final figures will be published on August 19, he said.
In the first half of last year, MMK reported turnover of 5.3 billion schillings and a pretax profit of 371 million schillings.
The company posted an operating profit of 218 million schillings for the first quarter of 1997.
